name: handle-condition-neither-visible-nor-not-visible-accepted
description: a handle branch's `when` with neither `visible` nor `notVisible` set is accepted, unlike a precondition check, because HandleConditionSchema carries no zod refine enforcing exactly one of the two.
yaml:
- launchApp
- handle:
    - when: {}
      do:
        - back
    - otherwise: skip
